issue.title: react: Escape doesn't leave editing mode, and the discarded edit is saved on blur
issue.body:
**Spec** (app-spec.md, Editing): "If escape is pressed during the edit, the edit state should be left and any changes be discarded."

**Steps** (`examples/react/dist`)
1. Add a todo "buy milk".
2. Double-click it, change the text to "changed", press Escape.
3. Click the "What needs to be done?" input.

**Expected:** after step 2 the item leaves editing mode and shows "buy milk"; step 3 changes nothing.

**Actual:** after step 2 the `<li>` keeps the `editing` class and the edit input stays visible. After step 3 the todo is saved as "changed", so the edit was never discarded.

The Cypress test `should cancel edits on escape` only asserts the label text right after Escape, so it passes. Asserting that `.editing` is gone, or blurring afterwards, would catch this.

**Environment:** commit `ff43b02` (current main), app served statically, Chromium 156 driven by Playwright.

Found while testing the official implementations against `app-spec.md` with an AI browser agent ([UIPilot](https://github.com/kennywu411-dev/uipilot)). Every step above was re-checked with a deterministic Playwright script using real mouse and keyboard events.
